hero.desc: We are building an integrated circular bioeconomy facility in Poland: a 400 kW biogas plant as Phase I, with optional extensions — a Black Soldier Fly insect farm and an AI Compute centre.
hero.subdesc: Stable, regulated revenue from a 15-year feed-in tariff · simple operating model · long-term partnerships with local farms.

vision.label: Business goal
vision.title: What we build
vision.intro: AInsekt Farm is a long-term infrastructure venture in renewable energy and circular bioeconomy. We are not chasing quick returns — we are building an asset that generates stable, regulated revenue for 15 years and creates real value for local agriculture.
vision.goalDesc: Build and commission a standalone 400 kW biogas CHP plant by September 2029 — producing 2,452 MWh per year of controllable 24/7 baseload, independent of weather.
vision.missionDesc: Close the loop of organic waste in Polish agriculture. Every ton of substrate from a local farm — potatoes, silage, apples — becomes energy, heat and organic fertilizer that returns to the same fields.
vision.visionDesc: A network of sister SPVs across Poland — each biogas plant a standalone, self-financing unit. Poland as the reference market for scaling the model across Central Europe through 2030 and beyond.

streams.label: Six platform pillars
streams.title: Phase I is a standalone asset.
streams.titleGreen: Phases II and III are additional growth.
streams.desc: The 400 kW biogas plant defends itself economically — without further phases. The optional insect farm and AI Compute centre are financed exclusively from Phase I cash flow and additional public support.
streams.flikDesc: CSTR reactor in high-efficiency cogeneration · 400 kWel + 460 kWth · 2,452 MWh per year · controllable baseload for the power system.
streams.bsfDesc: 974 PLN per MWh for 15 years from commissioning · regulatory guarantee through 2044 · predictable, indexed revenue.
streams.btcDesc: 5,500 tons per year from four logistics zones within 120 km · safety margin of +11 percentage points above the regulatory threshold.
streams.aiDesc: Operational marketplace for organic waste · direct channel for sourcing agricultural substrate · automated supplier ↔ plant matchmaking.
streams.biogasDesc: Optional extension from 2031 · 1,200 m² Black Soldier Fly facility · 53 t meal + 22 t oil + 900 t fertilizer per year · uses waste heat.
streams.heatDesc: Optional extension from 2032 · 16 NVIDIA H100/H200 class GPUs powered by biogas · green compute offering with a price premium for B2B clients.

energy.label: Energy architecture · Phase I
energy.title: 400 kW in high-efficiency cogeneration.
energy.desc: CSTR reactor with mesophilic fermentation at 38–42°C · main fermenter 1,500 m³ and post-fermenter 1,200 m³ · 35-day retention · 2,452 MWh per year of controllable 24/7 baseload.
energy.btcDesc: 2,452 MWh per year net · tariff of 974 PLN per MWh for 15 years · revenue ~€565K per year · regulatory guarantee within the Polish renewables support scheme.
energy.aiDesc: Around 460 kW thermal · 15% to maintain fermenter temperature · 85% available for a local off-taker or the future Phase II · upside +€30–50K per year.
energy.heatDesc: Around 4,800 tons per year · sold to local farms as organic fertilizer · 2,500 m³ storage tank meeting the 6-month retention requirement.

flik.label: FLIK App · live
flik.title: Circular-economy waste
flik.desc: FLIK is an operational app connecting biogas plants, supermarkets, farmers and businesses. It is the direct, operational channel for sourcing agricultural substrate for Phase I.
flik.subdesc: Real-time map · automated reservations · optimized delivery routes · CSRD ESG reports · audit trail for grant applications.
flik.biogasDesc: Capacity registration · real-time waste matching · framework supply agreements · letters of intent for investment projects.
flik.supermarketsDesc: Expiry countdown · organized waste collection · gate fee €30–35 per ton · Zero Waste certificate for ESG reports.
flik.farmersDesc: Substrate collection — potatoes, silage, apples · digestate orders as organic fertilizer · validation letters of intent.
flik.individualsDesc: Buy near-expiry food · report waste · earn Green Points loyalty rewards.
flik.businessesDesc: Organic waste pickup planning · bulk purchasing · CSRD ESG reporting with a full compliance audit trail.
flik.mapDesc: Live positions of near-expiry products, waste pickup points, biogas capacity and farmer stands. Refreshed every 5 minutes.
flik.countdownDesc: Automatic markdowns as expiry approaches: 48h = 20%, 24h = 40%, 12h = 60%, 6h = 80%. Unsold items automatically routed to biogas.
flik.gpDesc: Automatic matching of waste streams to the nearest plant · four logistics zones · continuous per-ton cost optimization.
flik.reservDesc: Reserve products 1–48 hours in advance. Generate preliminary letters of intent for grant projects with an audit trail.
flik.nftDesc: Monthly certificate for companies at four tiers: bronze, silver, gold and platinum. CSRD-compliant. Real proof of impact.
flik.agentDesc: Recipe suggestions for near-expiry food · CO₂ impact calculator · automated ESG reports · routing waste to the optimal destination.

token.label: Project financing
token.title: Public renewables support
token.desc: The Phase I project qualifies for Polish and EU renewables support programmes. Applications are in preparation — target submission in the 2027 call cycle. The financing strategy combines investment support, a preferential loan and investor equity.
token.gpRewardsDesc: Main support instrument we qualify for — European Funds for Infrastructure, Climate and Environment (National Fund for Environmental Protection). Target: 2027 call cycle after full documentation is ready.
token.stakingDesc: Regional Fund for Environmental Protection. Preferential loan covering equity contribution — available alongside the main investment support.
token.btcDesc: If call schedules or qualification rules change, we have an alternative path — the FENX.02.02 programme (renewables development) or dedicated NFOŚiGW instruments.
token.daoDesc: In parallel we are applying to EU innovation programmes dedicated to deep-tech in circular economy and renewable energy.
token.computeDesc: Proprietary AI solutions for fermentation monitoring and FLIK integration qualify for a dedicated R&D support component.
token.discountDesc: We have a fully documented fallback option — a 199 kW pilot installation. Lower capex, shorter schedule, no full environmental decision required. Activated if access to the main support is restricted.

roadmap.label: Implementation schedule
roadmap.title: 27 months
roadmap.p1Desc: Preliminary letters of intent from substrate suppliers · URE interpretation request · land search 1.5–2 hectares · EPC quotes from five contractors · project documentation.
roadmap.p2Desc: AInsekt Farm Sp. z o.o. incorporation (June–July 2027) · three binding LOIs from suppliers · land purchase · grid-connection application to OSD · environmental KIP submission.
roadmap.p3Desc: Environmental Decision (DUŚ, 6 months) · zoning permit · two–three binding EPC offers · public support application submission · R&D component.
roadmap.p4Desc: Building permit · contract with selected EPC (Jenbacher, MWM or WELTEC) · 12-month construction: earthworks, foundations, fermenter tanks, CHP engine room, storage infrastructure.
roadmap.p5Desc: First MWh into the grid · 15-year guaranteed tariff clock starts (through 2044) · full logistics loop · first full Q4 2029 financials · planned expansion to a second module from 2030.

legal.label: Legal structure and partners
legal.title: Built in
legal.chDesc: Phase I SPV · 400 kW biogas plant in Opolskie or Lower Silesia voivodeship · incorporated June–July 2027 · 100% founder ownership through commissioning.
legal.uaDesc: Energy Regulatory Office (URE) — guaranteed tariff, interpretations, 15-year revenue guarantee. Reference price 1,025 PLN per MWh set by the Ministry of Climate (Polish Journal of Laws 2023 item 2440).
legal.plDesc: Four logistics zones within 120 km of the plant · long-term partnerships with local farms · three binding LOIs in preparation for Q3–Q4 2026.
